from collections import Counter
import os
from mathhint_solver import ThreeWayGeneration as three
from mathhint_solver import CompareGeneration as comparison
config, plan = three.prepare_plan(three.ROOT, three.PREDICTIONS)
manifest = comparison.read_json(three.OUTPUT / "config.json")
assert comparison.digest(config) == manifest["config_id"]
completed = comparison.load_completed(three.OUTPUT, manifest["config_id"])
pending = [item for item in plan if completed.get((item["id"], item["method"]), {}).get("status") != "success"]
assert all(item["method"] == "oracle_hint" for item in pending)
assert os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")
three.run_experiment(three.OUTPUT, config, plan, api_key=os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"], workers=2, interval=5.0)
